title: Scholarships for students with a refugee background (NRWege ins Studium)

provider.name: University of Bonn / Ministry of Culture and Science of NRW

summary: NRWege ins Studium supports students of the University of Bonn who have a refugee history with monthly scholarships.

degree_levels.notes: Can be applied for before study program starts as long as enrolled as a student of the University of Bonn.

institutions.notes: Must be enrolled as a student of the University of Bonn.

nationality.notes: Refugee background with specific criteria (BAMF decision, temporary/humanitarian protection, residence permit for admission from abroad, no final deportation order, no settlement permit). University entrance qualification obtained abroad.

residence.notes: Must have arrived in Germany within the past 5 years since first being funded by NRWege (extendable to 7 years under conditions). Living in Germany.

mandatory.text: Refugee status meeting program specifications (received first BAMF decision, temporary protection, protection on humanitarian grounds, residence permit for admission from abroad, no final deportation order, no settlement permit)
University entrance qualification equivalent to Abitur obtained abroad (not at a German school)
Arrived in Germany within the past 5 years since first being funded by NRWege (extendable up to 7 years with underage children, family care, or illness)
Enrollment or letter of admission as a student of the University of Bonn starting from winter term 2025/26
Willingness to participate in counselling and activities within the NRWege program

preferences.text: Strong motivation for achievement and interest in your subject
Social engagement can be a plus (active membership in an association, social and political engagement, cultural activities)

funding.description: €300 per month for a scholarship complementing an income of max. €992; up to €992 per month for full scholarships in individual cases if not eligible to BAföG.
funding.duration: October 2025 to September 2026 with option of extension

required_documents.text: Letter of motivation (one or two pages)
Transcript of records (or certificate of German language skills with grade if about to start study program)
Certificate of enrollment or letter of admission from the University of Bonn
Copy of residence permit or first BAMF decision
BAföG decision or proof of application for BAföG
Informal disclosure of general financial situation
If applicable, proof of income from sources of public funding other than BAföG
If applicable, proof of income from a part-time job or other activities
If applicable or mandatory (4th semester or above), letter of recommendation
If applicable, proof of social engagement or outstanding achievements
If applicable, proof of previous funding by NRWege

steps.text: Complete the application form and upload requested application documents
Participate in an interview via Zoom if applying for a full scholarship of €934

sources.title: Costs and Financing for International Students — University of Bonn
sources.notes: Students with refugee background enrolled at the University of Bonn in Germany.
